item.description: Authorities are bringing in more resources as they try to track down one hiker who is still unaccounted for and may have been hiking in the Grand Canyon’s lower rim when dangerous flood floods swept through the popular area. It comes as officials confirm they have discovered the bodies of two men. Crews are now assessing the catastrophic damage, including to a pipe system that carries fresh water. NBC’s Dana Griffin reports for TODAY.

item.description: Chilling images are emerging of a deadly stabbing spree in New York’s Times Square in broad daylight on Monday. Police say a woman stabbed two people in 20 seconds, including a 68-year-old man in the side and a 32-year-old woman in the abdomen who later died from her wounds. The woman, who police say had multiple documented mental health incidents in previous years, was shot and killed by officers on the scene. NBC’s Sam Brock reports for TODAY. Warning: Some of the video is disturbing.
